b|.body: By dawn the buoy's battery had gone flat, and the ping on the south reef stopped for the first time in twenty-four years. The tapes went back into the lamp-room locker, where Walt had left them for whoever came next. Arthur took the relief boat home to a house he could finally walk through. On sixteen, in the mornings, Clara still says good morning to the rock.

c|.body: The report went to the Coast Guard with Arthur's signature on it: thorough, accurate, and dated the seventh. It reopened nothing for June, and it ended Clara's career at Station Penobscot. She did not answer on sixteen again. The beam turned all that winter for no one, and the relief boat, when it came, found the radio switched off.
